name: Black & White
source:
In this world cat-girls are inferior to people, but only rich persons can afford one. Main character gets a chance to train such cat-girl for a limited time to get a huge reward.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在这个世界中，猫耳少女地位低于人类，但只有富人才能养得起一个。主人公得到了一个限时调教猫耳少女的机会，以获得巨额报酬。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-december-2005-yatohime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
